verbatim_quote.original: ORDER 1: encode the standing rule 'at approval gates (plan approval, review approval, closure approval) the Hands MUST collect approval via the question tool, because the goal-plugin loop rolls past prose questions' into agents/cognitive-executor.md and the generated system-prompt.md (via its source fragments). verbatim_quote.english_translation: ORDER 1: encode the standing rule 'at approval gates (plan approval, review approval, closure approval) the Hands MUST collect approval via the question tool, because the goal-plugin loop rolls past prose questions' into agents/cognitive-executor.md and the generated system-prompt.md (via its source fragments). extracted_decision.summary: Mandate the question tool for all approval gates (plan, review, closure) in cognitive-executor and source fragments, because prose questions are rolled past by the goal-plugin loop.
extracted_decision.rationale: Prose-only approval requests are not reliable under the goal-plugin loop; the question tool ensures explicit collection. Existing Capability Preflight only describes relay behavior, not the mandate.
alternatives: Rely on executor frontmatter permission only
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Question tool may be unavailable in some runtimes; must pause and relay rather than skip; Adds mandatory tool interaction at gates; Requires fragment edits and system-prompt regeneration
